description: Ten unprotected ADTS frames of two channel pair blocks each, then three bytes that belong to no block.
findings: 10 raw data blocks hold bytes after their END element

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg decodes the bytes after the END element as a further block.
skip.faad: faad2 reads one raw data block per ADTS frame.
skip.faad_trace: faad2 reads one raw data block per ADTS frame.
skip.decode: ffmpeg decodes the bytes after the END element as a further block, which fails.
